stories.title: Nevada County Supervisors approve $500,000 grant to support Penn Valley Community Center
stories.summary: The Nevada County Board of Supervisors approved a $500,000 grant to the Penn Valley Community Foundation at its August 25 meeting. The funding will support public infrastructure for the future Penn Valley Community Center.

stories.title: Sponsored: Stay safe from trips and falls: Free event shares resources and support
stories.summary: Falls are the leading cause of injury and injury-related death among older Americans, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. In fact, millions of Americans aged 65 and older fall and injure themselves every year.

stories.title: Return California looking to add its weight to firefighting from the ground up
stories.summary: On Friday, visitors were welcome to tour seven Nevada City properties that surround BLM land at the corner of Jones Bar and Owl Creek roads, a tour led by Return California.

stories.title: Cannabis lounges, pop-up events — among the first of their kind — could be coming soon to Nevada City
stories.summary: Nevada City may become known as a regional trailblazer in their support of the cannabis industry and efforts to loosen restrictions in the city’s cannabis code.

stories.title: Nevada County Probation Officer Ben Hertel honored for bravery after reviving man who suffered cardiac arrest during hockey game
stories.summary: Nevada County Probation Officer III Ben Hertel was honored Thursday in Roseville after saving a fellow hockey player who suffered cardiac arrest on the ice.

stories.title: Marc Cuniberti: One ounce of preventon
stories.summary: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure. An adage that probably is true to spades in most cases. Prevention can help us avoid or perhaps at least minimize accidents, mishaps, injuries, financial damage to portfolios and more.

stories.title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
stories.summary: The latest escalation in an ongoing trade war between the US and Canada will see new levies on goods from steel to furniture, fresh tuna and makeup.

stories.title: China hits out at 'illegal' new US sanctions on Iran and trading partners
stories.summary: The US has threatened to isolate nations that continue to do business with Tehran, which sells much of its oil to Beijing.

stories.title: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
stories.summary: Flight tracking data confirms an American military aircraft travelled to Russia from the US via Latvia on Tuesday.

stories.title: Mass arrests in global crackdown on West African cyber-crime networks
stories.summary: The operation included the arrest of 39 people in South Africa for romance and investment scams.

stories.title: Brain disease in dead NFL players 'higher than previously shown'
stories.summary: A new study says at least one in four ex-NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 had a degenerative brain disease but the true figure could be much higher.

stories.title: Tornado tears through French village, leaving dozens hurt and homes ravaged
stories.summary: The south-western village of Pomas was hardest hit, with hundreds of homes damaged and fifteen people taken to hospital.

stories.title: Does 'rewilded' land need better wildfire prevention measures?
stories.summary: RSPB is considering measures it can take to improve resilience in the wake of a five week long fire

stories.title: Toxic waste sites exposed in Michael Sheen documentary 'tip of the iceberg'
stories.summary: One scientist says there are thousands of sites across the UK that need investigating.

stories.title: Relief may be near for Indiana city after days without power
stories.summary: After nearly two-weeks without power, Gary, Indiana residents and officials call for accountability, infrastructure improvements, and customer relief measures.

stories.title: Songs created by AI banned from Australia's music charts
stories.summary: The move comes weeks after a DJ admitted using AI to remix a Madonna song that topped the Australian charts.

stories.title: Sharing dangerous driving videos is 'truly reprehensible', PM says
stories.summary: His comments come as the government urged TikTok and other social media firms to remove wrong-way driving videos.

stories.title: Twitch and Amazon face legal action over using livestreams to train AI
stories.summary: The lawsuit alleges Twitch used streamers' videos to train AI without their permission or proper compensation.
